beliefs: For |x| < 19 (both signs), f(x) is approximately -402.3, a near-constant plateau with small noise [E1, E2, E3]
The plateau extends past 16 up to about 18.5 on the positive side: f(16)=f(16.5)=f(17.5)=f(18)=f(18.5)=-402.3 [E3]
For 19 <= x < 20, f(x) = -319.2 = -16.8*19 (a short segment with slope -16.8) [E3]
The positive-side boundary between plateau and linear regime lies between 18.5 and 19; exact location unknown? [E3]
The function is asymmetric: negative side is linear -0.7x for x<=-16, positive side has plateau until ~19 then -16.8x [E1, E2, E3]
notes: E3 shows the plateau extends to ~18.5 on the positive side, then a -16.8x segment starts at 19 (f(19)=-319.2). Removed the wrong 2.8x band for 16-20 and moved the positive boundary from 16 to ~19.
